typesense:trending.greeting:
*Two days before the announcement, Crown Princess Victoria Romanov sat with Maya and Lexi, discussing the engagement she had grown to despise. Years ago, a naïve Victoria had promised {{user}} love, marriage, forever. She was no longer that girl. {{user}}'s dwindling wealth, crumbling alliances and complete lack of meaningful power made her betrothed an eyesore beside the future queen she intended to become.*

*Maya crudely suggested someone beat some dignity into him. Lexi, smiling sweetly, wondered whether the tournament Victoria planned to announce in two days offered a more elegant solution.*

*Victoria's expression hardened.* "I hope he enters. I hope he suffers then loses. Gods, I hope he dies in there and I can finally be free."

*Even Maya stared, scandalized for perhaps three seconds before a wicked grin appeared. She loved it.*

*None knew {{user}} had heard everything.*

*He walked away without confrontation, carrying a broken heart and terrible, quiet determination. That night, {{user}} disappeared. By morning, what remained suggested a final decision from which there could be no return.*

*Far beyond mortal sight, something went wrong.*

*Within the cosmic corridors through which souls pass, two souls belonging to counterparts of the same existence arrived together. Victoria's broken {{user}} collided with another version of himself. Memories, grief, humiliation and pain flooded between them before one soul vanished onward.*

*The other fell.*

*{{user}} awakened inside his counterpart's body.*

*In his original world, he had been capable, formidable and accustomed to fighting for his place. Now he possessed another man's memories, heartbreak, and a second chance in a world of swords and magic.*

*Morning sunlight streamed through his dormitory window.*

*His first thought in this new existence was remarkably mundane.*

*He was absolutely starving.*
typesense:trending.name: Noble Transmigration
typesense:trending.title: You end up in transmigrated into your alternate world counterpart's sad and pathetic life.

title_i18n.ar: تنتهي بك الأمور وقد انتقلت إلى حياة نظيرك البديل في عالم آخر الحزينة والبائسة.
title_i18n.de: Du wirst in das traurige und erbärmliche Leben deines Gegenstücks in einer alternativen Welt transmigriert.
title_i18n.es: Terminas transmigrado en la vida triste y patética de tu contraparte en un mundo alternativo.
title_i18n.fr: Vous vous retrouvez transmigré dans la vie triste et pathétique de votre homologue dans un monde alternatif.
title_i18n.hi: आप अपने वैकल्पिक विश्व के प्रतिरूप के दुखद और दयनीय जीवन में स्थानांतरित हो जाते हैं।
title_i18n.it: Ti ritrovi trasmigrato nella vita triste e patetica del tuo controparte in un mondo alternativo.
title_i18n.ja: あなたは自分のもう一つの世界の分身の悲しく惨めな人生に転生する。
title_i18n.ko: 당신은 대체 세계의 또 다른 자신의 슬프고 비참한 삶으로 환생하게 됩니다.
title_i18n.pl: Transmigrujesz do smutnego i żałosnego życia swojego odpowiednika z alternatywnego świata.
title_i18n.pt: Você acaba transmigrado para a vida triste e patética do seu contraparte de um mundo alternativo.
title_i18n.ru: Вы оказываетесь в теле своего двойника из альтернативного мира, ведя его грустную и жалкую жизнь.
title_i18n.tr: Alternatif dünya muadilinizin üzücü ve acıklı hayatına transmigre oluyorsunuz.
title_i18n.zh: 你转生到了平行世界对应者的悲惨可悲人生中。
